_comment: Hand-authored (not from models.dev): the ChatGPT Codex-backend model list is dynamic (filter_by_auth) and not published on models.dev. These are the current GPT-5.6 models reachable through ChatGPT-account login against https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex. They intentionally mirror the latest OpenAI API ids; callers must use the explicit openai-chatgpt profile when the same id exists under another provider. structured_output:true on all three (finding [7]): this profile is ProtocolFamily::OpenAiResponses end to end (catalog/presets.rs), whose codec (`providers/openai_responses.rs::encode_text_controls`) fully encodes `ResponseFormat::JsonSchema` as the Responses API `text.format` object (`{type, strict, schema, name}`, pinned to codex-rs common.rs TextFormat) unconditionally for every model on the protocol — there is no per-model capability check in the encoder. The field was previously omitted (models.dev has no entry for these hand-authored rows) rather than deliberately false, and its absence made every judge_eligible row in a ChatGPT-subscription-only install fail FusionError::StructuredOutputUnsupported before any panel call.
name: OpenAI (ChatGPT login)
